name: Varv
description: A goblin who burned his home, weapons and killed his friend Furt in rage.

description_citations.text: Scourge: card flavor text (Scourge, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Varv destroys his home and weapons in rage and kills his friend Furt.
timeline.quote: Only when the anger passed did Varv realize he had burned down his home, destroyed his weapons, and killed his friend Furt.
